name: Merit Excellence Scholarship
description: Awarded to high-achieving students demonstrating academic excellence and leadership potential.
requirements: Minimum 3.5 GPA, demonstrated leadership experience, enrolled in accredited institution

name: STEM Futures Scholarship
description: Supporting students pursuing careers in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.
requirements: STEM major, minimum 3.0 GPA, demonstrated interest in STEM fields

name: Women in Technology Scholarship
description: Empowering women to pursue careers in technology and computer science.
requirements: Female student, technology-related major, minimum 3.2 GPA

name: Community Service Leadership Award
description: Recognizing students who have made significant contributions to their communities.
requirements: 100+ hours of community service, letters of recommendation, any major

name: No Essay Achievement Scholarship
description: Merit-based scholarship requiring no essay submission - based on GPA and achievements only.
requirements: Minimum 3.7 GPA, transcript submission, achievement portfolio

name: Future Business Leaders Scholarship
description: Supporting students pursuing business, economics, and entrepreneurship studies.
requirements: Business-related major, leadership experience, minimum 3.3 GPA

name: Arts and Creativity Scholarship
description: Celebrating creative students in visual arts, music, theater, and creative writing.
requirements: Arts major, portfolio submission, minimum 2.8 GPA

name: First Generation College Student Scholarship
description: Supporting first-generation college students in their educational journey.
requirements: First generation college student, financial need demonstration, minimum 2.5 GPA

name: Healthcare Heroes Scholarship
description: Supporting future healthcare professionals and medical students.
requirements: Healthcare-related major, volunteer experience in healthcare, minimum 3.4 GPA

name: Environmental Stewardship Scholarship
description: Awarded to students committed to environmental conservation and sustainability.
requirements: Environmental science or related major, environmental project involvement, minimum 3.1 GPA
